**Volume:** X20

**Byline:** 明 受汰集
**Dynasty:** 明

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X362 is [受汰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%97%E6%B1%B0)'s four-fascicle Ming-period topical-with-annotation (科註) edition of *[Jīnguāngmíng jīng 金光明經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301)* (T663). The genre combines a *kē* 科 (structural outline) with a *zhù* 註 (running annotation): the sūtra is laid out under nested topical headings, each followed by an exegetical note. The *Jiāxìng* 嘉興 edition is the textual basis preserved in the *Xuzangjing*; the editing brings together the Tiāntái commentarial line.

**Abstract**

The work is therefore a synthetic Tiāntái commentary: a Ming-period assemblage of the school's complete commentarial position on [T663](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301), drawing from [T1783](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304), [T1785](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306), [T1784](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305), and [T1786](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307) under [受汰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%97%E6%B1%B0)'s editorial frame. Date bracket conservatively follows the generic "Ming dynasty" ascription of [受汰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%97%E6%B1%B0) in the DILA Authority record (A000553). [受汰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%97%E6%B1%B0) was a *bhikṣu* of the Ān-guósì 安國寺 in Yánguān 鹽官 (modern Hǎiníng) and a disciple of Tóngxī Héshàng 桐谿和尚.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301) (金光明經 / T663); preceding Tiāntái commentaries [KR6i0304](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304), [KR6i0306](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306) and their subcommentaries [KR6i0305](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305), [KR6i0307](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307).
